name: Westhausen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, green, white, green and white, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Westhausen (a yellow fleur-de-lis on red).
history: Municipal flag of Westhausen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Westhausen arms — yellow fleur-de-lis on red
